about: Club rulings per park (ANSWERS_round3.md, Nov 1 2026). 'pin only' = no official layer yet: the engine keeps looking for the managing agency's own layer; a new find is only a candidate for chat 11. 'hold' = nothing is offered as a question until the club lifts it. 'note' = recorded for people only; the engine does not change the row. W-10 (Nov 1): the four WDPA-only parks were re-checked against Florida's conservation lands, PAD-US under other names and the federal layers; each 'official_found' list is evidence for chat 11, not a decision.

US-0658.tag: official layer exists (W-10): WDPA rejected; question for chat 11
US-0658.why: W-10 (Nov 1): WDPA is rejected because an official layer exists for this park. NPS Land Resources Division boundary 'Timucuan Ecological and Historic Preserve' (record 1047) has the POTA pin inside. PAD-US has it under that name (record 3312, not the POTA name 'Timucuan Preserve National Conservation Area'); Florida conservation lands has 'Timucuan Preserve Federally Managed Lands' (record 3006). Candidate only until chat 11 accepts.

GB-0889.tag: held by the club: a forestry record is the wrong kind for a National Nature Reserve
GB-0889.why: Glen Nant NNR matched a Forest Blocks (forestry) record. Wrong kind of record. Scotland: the right source is NatureScot's own Nature Reserve layer, not England's.

US-0896.why: W-10 (Nov 1): WDPA is rejected because an official layer exists for this park. The club already said YES (chat 11, Oct 31) to the USDA Forest Service Wild and Scenic River segment line 'Wekiva Wild and Scenic River' (record 523, pin 91 m from the line). WDPA's 'Lower Wekiva River' is the state's Lower Wekiva River land, not the river corridor. No WSR corridor polygon was found (NPS WSR boundaries: no record at the pin).

US-6281.tag: official layer exists (W-10): WDPA rejected; question for chat 11
US-6281.why: W-10 (Nov 1): WDPA is rejected because an official layer exists for this park.
